messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: 🔔 P1 - elevated 5xx for control-plane API (/v1/*). Trigger: 5xx rate > 5% across gateway for last 3m. Pages: oncall-rotation, sasha, matt. Link: https://ops.redwood/in/2930000000
sasha: ack'ing — I'm oncall now. seeing large spike in 502/504 + timeouts at the gateway layer. rolling counts: 5xx ~ 12% for last 5m, spikes in org-lookup and auth downstream errors in traces.
matt: on it. attaching initial traces: service=gateway -> auth-proxy (timeout) -> org-lookup (timeout). looks like timeouts rather than explicit 5xx from auth.
priya: I see config-service also getting a lot of retries. probably a fanout from auth token validation path hitting billing and org services. will pull logs.
sasha: quick customer impact: external API calls to /v1/generate and /v1/chat are returning 502/504. early estimate: ~20% of customer requests affected, some enterprise customers seeing errors. cs-lead can we start a holding notice draft?
cs-lead: yes. drafting short message: "We're currently investigating increased error rates for Redwood API. Some requests may fail with 5xx. We're working on mitigation and will update in 15 minutes." will share in #status once we have stable mitigation.
lee: handing over infra diagnostics: checking cluster metrics. auth-service pod OOMs? CPU spike? kube events show a bunch of restarts in auth-proxy around 12:31 UTC.
infra-bot: metrics snapshot: auth-proxy p95 latency 2.8s -> increased to 7.1s; org-lookup p95 3.6s -> 9.2s; request queue depth up x6.
sasha: suspect cascade: a recent config push (internal) that added a billing lookup during token validation. if billing latency increases, it could block auth path. matt can you confirm if call graph includes billing inside auth flow?
matt: yes — new call path introduced in last deploy: auth-service -> billing.check_subscription in token flow. I see recent deploy tag `config-2026-03-14` to auth-service. grabbing deploy timeline.
matt: `kubectl get deployment auth-service -o jsonpath='{.metadata.annotations.deployed}'` shows `2026-03-14T12:25Z config-2026-03-14`.
sasha: immediate mitigation: 1) disable billing lookup from auth flow (hotpatch / feature flag rollback) 2) enable cached org-lookup fallback 3) increase auth timeout to avoid blocking gateway.
priya: I can roll a hotpatch to flip `auth.billing_check_enabled=false` in the runtime feature flags store. preparing patch.
priya: patch command:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://config.redwood/internal/flags -d '{"auth.billing_check_enabled": false}'
```
priya: applying now...
priya: done. flag set propagated to all auth pods (rolling config-refetch). watching metrics.
infra-bot: note: flag update confirmed on 90% of pods. some pods still on old config due to readiness probes.
matt: also increasing auth downstream timeout from 500ms -> 1500ms to reduce 502s. applying via k8s rollout patch.
matt: `kubectl patch deployment auth-service -p '{"spec": {"template": {"spec": {"containers": [{"name":"auth","env":[{"name":"AUTH_TIMEOUT_MS","value":"1500"}] }]}}}}'`
matt: rollout started.
sasha: if the flag rollback + timeout increase reduces the cascade we can then scale org-lookup cache hit ratio and enable circuit breaker. priya can you enable cached fallback?
priya: enabling cached org lookup fallback now: flipping `org.lookup.cache_only=true` in config store.
priya: done.
infra-bot: within 90s of changes, 5xx rate down from 12% -> 2.2%. gateway latency dropping. continuing to monitor.
oncall-rotation: nice work. I'll stay on until this stabilizes, then hand to next oncall in 30m.
lee: evidence in logs: before mitigation:
```
ERROR auth: timeout waiting for billing.check_subscription (500ms)
WARN gateway: upstream auth-service returned 504
```
after mitigation:
```
INFO auth: billing check disabled by flag
INFO auth: fallback -> org-lookup cache hit
```
sasha: prepping customer comms: cs-lead please hold the status update for another 10m until we confirm stability. include that mitigation steps taken (disabled billing lookup in auth; enabled org cache; increased timeouts). add ETA for full root cause analysis.
cs-lead: ack. will post in 10m with current numbers.
matt: rollout finished, all auth pods at new timeout and feature flag. health checks returning green. `kubectl rollout status deployment/auth-service` returned success.
infra-bot: current metrics: 5xx rate 0.9%, p95 latency back to ~350ms for gateway, auth p95 420ms.
sasha: good. plan next: 1) postmortem + RCA 2) revert the config change in staging and add canary gating for any cross-service syncs 3) add circuit breaker on billing calls 4) add metric alert for internal billing latency affecting auth path.
priya: creating incident ticket: https://issues.redwood/INC-2930000 - will attach logs and timeline.
cs-lead: posted status update: "Mitigation in place: we disabled a billing check in auth, enabled cached lookups, and increased auth timeouts. Error rates have dropped substantially. Investigation ongoing."
lee: tagging owners: @matt to lead RCA on deploy; @priya to own config gating; infra to propose circuit breaker change.
matt: initial root cause hypothesis: a config deploy introduced a synchronous billing lookup during token validation which wasn't properly canaried — under load billing latency spiked causing auth to block and cascade to gateway 5xx.
sasha: agreed. we'll do full RCA tomorrow with timeline and action items. for now moving to monitoring mode. next oncall please pick up at 2026-03-14T14:30Z (30m from now) - oncall-rotation will handoff.
oncall-rotation: handing to @lee for next 30m watch. leaving notes in the ticket. ping me if anything regresses.
lee: ack. leaving alert thresholds lowered for auth latency. will also add temporary rate-limit on internal billing calls to avoid repeat cascade.
infra-bot: alerting note: reopened paging notifications if 5xx > 1.5% sustained for 3m.
sasha: thanks team. good quick mitigation. we'll fill out postmortem and preventative playbook entries. closing thread once RCA doc posted.
matt: uploading logs and traces to the incident ticket. adding list of affected customers and mitigation timeline.
priya: adding feature flag rollout checklist to prevent future wide sweeps.
cs-lead: scheduling a customer follow-up for affected enterprise customers. drafting sample email.
lee: final check: 5xx steady at 0.8% for 10m. moving to resolved-monitoring state. will update ticket with resolution notes.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: error rate returned to acceptable thresholds. Incident closed in monitoring. Refer to INC-2930000 for RCA and next steps.
